patch.objective: Identify and manage multiple relationships, conflicts of interest and boundary issues
secondaryObjectives: Uphold client rights: access to records, complaints, termination and avoiding abandonment

sources.cite: APA, Ethical Principles of Psychologists and Code of Conduct (2002, amended 2010 and 2016, effective 2017-01-01): 1.04, 1.05 (reporting does not apply when an intervention would violate confidentiality rights), 3.04, 3.05(a)-(b) (multiple relationships not reasonably expected to impair or harm are not unethical), 4.01, 4.02, 4.05(b), 10.10(c)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 on apa.org (summarizing fetch with short quotes, e.g. 3.05(a) 'refrain from entering into a multiple relationship if' it could impair objectivity or risk harm; 10.10(c) 'prior to termination psychologists provide pretermination counseling and suggest alternative service providers'). Paraphrased, not reproduced.

sources.cite: ASPPB, EPPP (Part 1-Knowledge) content areas: Ethical, legal and professional issues 16%; Assessment and diagnosis 16%; Treatment, intervention, prevention and supervision 15%; Cognitive-affective bases 13%; Growth and lifespan development 12%; Biological bases 10%
sources.note: Relayed from the EPPP course seed (backend/supabase/seed/tracks/eppp.ts, read 2026-11-10 and re-checked for the course); not re-read for this case.

sources.cite: WAC 246-924-357, Multiple relationships (WSR 93-07-036): no undertaking or continuing a professional relationship with a client when a personal, financial, supervisory, political, administrative or legal relationship with the client or a related person impairs (or could impair) objectivity; if so, end it with notice, in an appropriate manner, and help the client obtain services from another professional
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 on the Legislature's page for the section (summarizing fetch with short quotes: 'The psychologist shall not undertake or continue a professional relationship with a client'; authority RCW 18.83.050(5)). The list of relationship kinds is paraphrased from that summary.

sources.cite: Chapter 70.02 RCW as the Washington jurisprudence course records it: 70.02.030 (a valid authorization is in writing, dated and signed, names the information, the recipient and the patient, and has an expiration date or event); 70.02.230 (mental health records stay confidential except as the chapter allows)
sources.note: Relayed from the course seed (wa-psych-jurisprudence.ts, read 2026-11-14); not re-read for this case.
The objective and secondary objectives are the course's own titles.
